room_state_entity.title: Room State
room_state_entity.description: Global state for a shared workspace room, tracking aggregate counts of active sounds and active user moods.

user_count.description: Number of users currently inside this room.

mood_counts.description: A map of mood identifiers to active count of users.

active_sounds.description: A map of sound IDs to active counts.

message_entity.title: Ambient Message
message_entity.description: A temporary short text post left by a user in the room that drifts across the screen and fades away.

text.description: The message text limit of 70 characters.

userCountry.description: Inferred or estimated random aesthetic country name for lofi vibe.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the message was posted.

presence_entity.title: User Presence
presence_entity.description: Realtime heartbeat document for a single connected anonymous user tab.

country.description: Aesthetic country or location of the user.

activeSounds.description: List of sound IDs currently toggled active by this user.

x.description: Visual coordinate x percentage (0 - 100) for screen floating orb rendering.

y.description: Visual coordinate y percentage (0 - 100) for screen floating orb rendering.

lastActive.description: Server timestamp of active presence heartbeat.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Shared rooms. We default to a global room named 'cozy-lounge'.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Short ambient drift comments created by players in the room.

/rooms/{roomId}/presences/{presenceId}.description: Individual live heartbeat records for online users.
